items.q: INTERVIEWER: Okay, the last few minutes we have on this tape we might as well go back to Harlan Dickson of Doyle and Dickson. >> [INTERVIEWEE] And Brothers. What about them? Harlan and Darlan is brothers. The Dickson brothers. What about them -- at the Palace Theater. Back in 1925, '24.
